turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Hey Dana, you there? Can you hear me okay?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yeah, loud and clear. Sorry I'm late, my build took forever.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: No worries. So, about Project Nebula, we need to lock the plan before Friday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Right, got it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Okay, three things are left. First, the matchmaking API still times out after about thirty seconds. Second, there's a nasty bug in the inventory screen. And third, Marcus is out until Monday.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Wait, what?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yeah, his flight got moved. His pull request for the inventory fix is still waiting for review.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Okay, I'll review it right after this call. Honestly, I'm more worried about the lag on the Frankfurt servers.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yeah.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Players in Brazil are seeing a ping of around two hundred and fifty milliseconds, which is way too high for a shooter.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That's rough. Can we spin up another region on AWS, maybe one in Sao Paulo?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It would cost around four hundred dollars a month, but I think it's worth it. We can test it on staging first.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Perfect. And the new boss? Players say his fire attack is way too strong.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yeah, I'll nerf it by fifteen percent and bump the cooldown from eight seconds to twelve.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Nice. Okay, the deploy is scheduled for Friday at six p.m. Pacific time. And we still need to write the patch notes for version two point four.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Hold on, Friday at six? That's three in the morning for Tom in Berlin.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Oh, right.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Let's do Thursday at noon instead, and keep Friday as a backup.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Works for me. I'll update the calendar and post it in the channel.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Awesome. Talk later?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Yep, see you tomorrow. And don't forget to push your branch before you log off.
